name: Anti-Meme Toy Box
description: Upon use, randomly applies 1 of the following effects to all allies in the next battle: increases ATK by 35%; decreases ATK by 10%.
story:
A fun little prank toy. Manufactured using antimemetic technology, no one can perceive what's inside the box. Give it to your friend and let curiosity torture them as they remain completely unable to cognize what's actually in the box!

"I don't understand what you mean... there's nothing in this box, right?"
"Haha, that's anti-meme! It's not that there's nothing there, it's that 'you can't perceive it.' Pretty interesting, huh?"
"No no no, I'm absolutely certain... this is an empty box. There's nothing inside."
"Let me see... *Arcadian expletive*, we've got a serious problem! That thing got out! Quick, call the Department of Aberration Defense!"
